risks.title: Dependence on government contracts
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that 97% of properties are leased and the company generates approximately 90% of its revenues by leasing properties to U.S. government agencies, either directly or through GSA. This concentration represents a significant risk in the event of policy changes or government budget reductions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions audit committee oversight of cybersecurity risks and collaboration with an external cybersecurity specialist provider. This indicates that cybersecurity is a recognized concern, but the language used does not suggest extreme urgency compared to other risks.

risks.title: Tenant revenue concentration
risks.score_rationale: Although the document details numerous tenants, the company mentions major government agencies as significant sources of rental income. A failure or departure of these large tenants could have notable impact.

risks.title: Aging real estate portfolio
risks.score_rationale: An aging portfolio may imply higher maintenance costs and asset value depreciation risk over the long term. The company recognized this situation by writing down a property by $2.5M upon fair value assessment.

risks.title: Risks related to joint ventures (JV)
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions a joint venture (JV) holding ten properties where the company holds a stake. Risks associated with JVs, such as partner disagreements or JV performance, are present but appear less critical than risks related to direct government contracts.

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: Although the text does not detail specific litigations, the nature of real estate activities and government contracts implies inherent risk of contractual or regulatory litigations. This risk is standard for the sector but not negligible.

ai_positioning.summary: DEA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. Information provided concerns mainly financial operations, properties and borrowings.
